Letters

Endorsing Adam Hundt for City Council

Pamela Strike Fullerton · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

Editor,

I am writing to endorse Adam Hundt for Piedmont City Council. I first met Adam while assisting him with his home search in Piedmont. During that process, I quickly came to appreciate his gentle, thoughtful manner and the respectful way he communicated his priorities, traits that I believe are essential for local leadership.

Adam is an exceptional candidate whose unique, highly relevant perspective makes him a strong asset for our city. His impressive academic background includes a bachelor’s degree from Brown, an MBA, a master’s in industrial engineering from the University of Michigan, and a master’s in public policy from Johns Hopkins with a focus on clean energy. This rigorous educational foundation underscores both his sharp intelligence and his drive.

Adam and his wife are raising their two young children here, and one of them attends Havens Elementary. His interest in local government grew from a desire to help Piedmont increase energy efficiency, an initiative that would lower our carbon footprint while boosting property values. Both are critical. While these issues inspired his run, his vision for our city is much broader.

While the Hundt family is relatively new to Piedmont, I deeply respect Adam’s commitment to getting involved and sharing his professional expertise. We need the fresh perspectives and energy that young families bring to navigate the complex issues ahead, and I believe Adam Hundt is exactly the kind of leader who will serve our community well.

–Pamela Strike Fullerton, Realtor Ramona Ave.
